approvals_one_open_per_revision.name: approvals_one_open_per_revision
approvals_one_open_per_revision.where: decision is null and revision_id is not null

approvals_revision_matches_target.name: approvals_revision_matches_target
approvals_revision_matches_target.value: coalesce(target->>'kind' = 'revision', false) = (revision_id is not null) and (revision_id is null or revision_id::text = target->>'revision_id')

approvals_decision_complete.name: approvals_decision_complete
approvals_decision_complete.value: (decision is null) = (decided_by is null) and (decision is null) = (decided_at is null)

assignments_site_writer_key.name: assignments_site_writer_key
assignments_site_writer_key.where: kind like 'site.%' and state not in ('queued', 'paused', 'published', 'failed', 'cancelled')

domains_name_lowercase_apex.name: domains_name_lowercase_apex
domains_name_lowercase_apex.value: name ~ '^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?(\.[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?)+$' and char_length(name) <= 253 and name not like 'www.%'

domains_purchase_shape.name: domains_purchase_shape
domains_purchase_shape.value: (origin::text = 'purchased') = (method::text = 'purchased') and (origin::text <> 'purchased' or price is not null) and (origin::text = 'purchased' or state::text not in ('awaiting_payment', 'abandoned'))

roles_org_read.name: roles_org_read
roles_org_read.using: org_id is null or org_id = nullif(current_setting('app.org_id', true), '')::uuid

users_member_read.name: users_member_read
users_member_read.using:
exists (
        select 1 from memberships m
        where m.user_id = users.id and m.org_id = nullif(current_setting('app.org_id', true), '')::uuid
      )
